1.End: Lately the symptoms of radiation sickness have become less and less pronounced. Your health has finally stabilized, and the disease is no longer a threat to your well-being. You have firmly decided that it pays to handle suspicious artifacts with extra care.
1.Name: Radiation Sickness
1.Next: Before fully recovering from radiation sickness, you were subjected to yet another strong dose of radiation. As the illness intensified, your condition was exacerbated, and complete recovery likely won't come until much later.
1.Start: You were subjected to a strong dose of radiation, the source presumably being the transfactorial beacon. You begin to feel nauseous. You nearly pass out from the combination of a splitting headache and exhaustion. As you finally gather your thoughts, you realize that these are all symptoms of radiation sickness,
1.Text: Appear after severe radiation exposure. The afflicted suffers diminished brain function, greatly reducing their learning capacity. The condition passes automatically after a month or two, depending on the severity of exposure. No treatment methods have been found as of yet.
1.TextEx: At your current condition you're loosing <Percent> of dominator kills experience. It's recommended to stay away from additional exposure to preserve your health.

0.End: Your eyesight has gradually returned to you. The blindness and stinging in your eyes are gone. Your body began to recover on its own. Your eyesight has become perfect.
0.Name: Blindness
Start: Your vision goes black for a minute...

This must be the delayed consequence of a tough battle, <clr>Blindness<clrEnd>! Opening your eyes, you notice that the contours of gauges on the panel have become blurred. You should head to a medical center before you overlook something truly important.
0.Text: The early stage of total blindness. Blurred vision of targets on the radar and in the immediate vicinity.

1.End: Your organism proved to be quite hardy. The nightmares began to gradually recede, while fits of delirium have disappeared altogether. Thanks to a healthy diet and regular exercise, you were able to singlehandedly defeat Chekumash, the deadliest virus of modern times.
1.Name: Chekumash
Start: You did not sleep well at night, tormented by nightmares. During the day your condition only worsened, visions persisted and strange things started happening all around.

You used your first-aid kit. The result was all too obvious. This is <clr>Chekumash<clrEnd>, one of the deadliest viruses in existence, developed by brilliant peleng scientists. The virus affects all races... Except for the mentally stable maloqs, naturally.

In this case we recommend visiting the nearest treatment center ASAP. Idle at your own risk! In the meantime, try not to be shocked at anything while you are sick. According to the ship's medical handbook, an infected pilot can experience visions even in outer space!
1.Text: Presence of imaginary objects in space: delirium-induced planets, nebulae. Otherworldly voices calling to the infected.

10.End: The intellectual overstrain of both frontal lobes has receded. The Aka Sezyanka is gradually fading away. You are once again capable of operating machinery and firing at several targets simultaneously.
10.Name: Aka Sezyanka
10.Start: You've been greatly overstraining your intellect of late. This is unacceptable for a fragile faeyan organism. An illness known as Aka Sezyanka has paralyzed all of your activities. The disease is common among the fae, making frequent use of one's frontal lobes very dangerous. Blood recedes from the brain, inhibiting brain activity by up to three times. When the brain gets to such a "molten" state, either a lengthy rest or an intensive therapy course at a treatment center is required. In other words, it's better to not think about anything.
10.Text: The afflicted loses focus. Their combat aim goes to hell, and they start losing equipment in open space. As an interesting side note, the brain's reduced response time has a positive effect on faeyans' commerce skill.

11.End:
End=
The hormonal activation stage is over. The gaalian New Molizone is no longer a threat, except for its latent form. Thankfully, in most cases gaals gain immunity for several years after recovery, enabling you to get back to trading.
11.Name: New Molizone
Start: You started exuding a rather peculiar smell. The ship's first-aid kit displayed the diagnosis: New Molizone. This notion is closely related to the "name carrier," i.e. the fetus. According to long-established standards, the infected host, which is essentially every mature gaal, carries a fetus which absorbs all of the host's thoughts and desires until the fetus assumes full control. After that, the fetus leaves the host body and becomes independent.

The fetuses undergo a period of hormonal activation, called "New Molizone." During this time the host's organism becomes toxic, making food and any other objects touched by the infected gaal hazardous for other living beings. At the same time, the process positively affects the host's reaction time, accuracy and mobility.

There are two treatment options. Wait until the hormonal activation stage is over: avoid handling food or medication, focusing on combat activities instead. Or undergo a deactivation course at a treatment center; naturally, this option is more sensible.
11.Text: Selling food or medication is strictly prohibited on all planets (and is deemed a contraband operation). Hormonal exchange is activated, leading to improved accuracy and mobility.

2.End: You got tired of hating the dominators. The Fanaticism virus has left your organism. Your reactions to different situations have improved, so you can put off that visit to a medical center for another time.
2.Name: Holy Fanaticism
Start: You start seeing things through a bloody red veil. A burning hatred towards robots is nagging at you to avenge the lives they have taken. In every shadow cast, in the details of every object you see the essence of dominators which must be eradicated.

Something is wrong... You turn to your first-aid kit, scanning the medical handbook in your mind. Of course -- this must be <clr>Fanaticism<clrEnd>, an ancient psychic virus affecting maloqs, pelengs and humans. If infected, rangers are advised to forget about dominators and complete a rehabilitation course at a medical center.
2.Text: In open space all ships appear to be dominators. All objects on all planets look dominator-made. Due to random outbreaks of rage, sane creatures begin to lose respect for the diseased humanoid. Charisma is reduced to a minimum, while accuracy, mobility and leadership skills are increased.

3.End: This is crazy! The tests show that your immune system is in perfect health. It's like you were never even sick with Complex Immunocide. No visit to medical center is required.
3.Name: Complex Immunocide
3.Start: You have completed a detailed examination of your system. And the results are not good. The test for Complex Immunocide came back positive. You have grown so weak that even the weakest virus is 100 times more likely to infect your organism. You need to get to a medical center for urgent treatment.
3.Text: The infected's immune system is compromised, making them far more susceptible to diseases. Contact with other races is not recommended.

4.End: Unfortunately, you have fully recovered from Luatanza. A telegram soon arrived from the Mystery of Luatan Fund, informing you that they would no longer be financing your illness.
4.Name: Mysterious Luatanza
4.Start: Suddenly you come down with Luatanza, which has a reputation as a "sudden" illness. But all the symptoms were there. No desire to sleep, eat or extort cargoes from merchant ships. That final symptom is especially devastating. But there is a bright side. The Mystery of Luatan Fund makes regular monetary transfers to the diseased's account, and generally treats them well. So you don't need to rush to a medical center just yet.
4.Text: The player cannot effectively fire, demand money or extort cargoes, but enjoys maximum reputation. Periodically a message arrives from the Luatan support fund, along with monetary aid for the diseased.

5.End: You've finally determined you were not going to take any more drugs and single-handedly overcome your addiction. This is just great!
5.Name: Drug Addiction
Start: You've realized that you're addicted to doping, and everything is going to hell. Your regular abuse of stimulators is doing you no good. You're a junkie now!!!
To save your dignity, or at least to stop your hands from shaking, you really should rush to a medical center. It's never too late to get help!
5.Text: The diseased becomes addicted to stimulators. His limbs shake and wear and tear of equipment is increased. Attack and mobility drop to a minimum.

6.End: Your concussion symptoms are suddenly gone. Your ears may still be ringing a bit, but that's it. Your Concussion has finally passed, and you're healthy again!
6.Name: Whirlwind Concussion
Start: An enemy shot hit your vessel and stripped some of its skin. You hit your head pretty hard and lost consciousness.
Having regained your senses, you realized you're feeling dizzy and nauseous. Looks like you've got a <clr>Concussion<clrEnd>. You need to undergo treatment at a medical center.
6.Text: A not-uncommon side effect of combat. Concussion disrupts sleep, resulting in impaired focus, thus lowering attack and mobility. The commerce skill vanishes altogether.

7.End: Your muscles have recovered and no longer hurt. And your spirits are higher than ever!
7.Name: Pulled Muscle
7.Start: In the heat of battle you pulled a muscle. Now the pain is making it hard to concentrate and take aim. Of course, your muscle will eventually recover on its own, but you can still seek treatment at a medical center.
7.Text: Severe pain obstructs movement, impairs concentration and the ability to give commands, thus lowering nearly all skills.

8.End: After months of being sick, you've finally stopped gaining weight, easily shedding more than half of the excess weight. The Grand Malosausus looks to have passed from your system. The key now is to stay away from stress, lest you relapse.
8.Name: Grand Malosausus
Start: All of a sudden you started gaining a lot of weight. Upon checking the rookie ranger medical handbook, you discover that these are symptoms of a disease called the Grand Malosausus. The infection affects over 92% of all maloqs. The illness is passive, developing gradually in your system, sometimes over the course of many years. Then, having claimed the entire organism, it manifests in stressful situations. With exposure to risk, the diseased experiences stress and starts gaining weight. Thus the organism compensates for its owner's losses on the moral front. The harder his life, the bigger the weight gain.
It's time to pay a visit to a medical center. Your system will not be able to easily defeat the illness on its own.
8.Text: The diseased maloq rapidly gains in physical mass and social influence. The changes are so significant that even the ship's mass becomes visibly larger, slowing down speed. Leadership and commerce skills rise by an order of magnitude.

9.End: All the symptoms of Bitter Pelenosia have disappeared. The unhealthy urge to break stuff is gone. You have regained full control of yourself and are no longer interested in monkeying around. How fortunate that this illness passes quickly.
9.Name: Bitter Pelenosia
Start: Suddenly you find yourself overcome with a desire to look inside every object and taste every component that's inside. You can hardly fight back the urge to dismantle and disassemble everything in sight. Stuff is starting to break down all the time. Upon conducting a self test, you make the correct diagnosis: Bitter Pelenosia, a peleng disease. It transforms the individual into an irritable child, itching to break something. Virtually every peleng is susceptible to this disease. There is a theory that the pervasiveness of Bitter Pelenosia is responsible for the inclinations of the race.

The disease comprises two stages: a lengthy incubation period and a fulminant peak. At the conclusion of the second stage, convalescence is almost instant. However, you wouldn't need to wait long if you visit a medical center, as the illness is easy treatable.
9.Text: A common childhood illness which also affects some adults. The diseased is unable to handle equipment properly, drastically reducing its service life.

Illness.EndDate: The illness will probably last till

0.End: The effect of the Maloq Sizha stimulant is over. Your accuracy and mobility skills have decreased.
0.Name: Maloq Sizha
0.Text: A liquid stimulant. Use once a year only, or else you will become addicted. Improves accuracy and mobility to nearly their maximum. It is not for nothing that this stimulant is often referred to as "the Devil's Luck."

1.End: The effect of the One-eyed Khamas stimulant is over, the creature died of exertion.
1.Name: One-eyed Khamas
1.Text: A peleng stimulant. In 3227 it was adopted for use by other races. Looks like a small one-eyed creature. The creature roots itself onto a humanoid, enters its brain, and imparts to it hypnotic abilities. Any ship that the pilot may claim tribute from will give away their goods without argument. On the downside, the stimulant negatively affects reputation, reducing leadership and charisma.

10.End: The effect of the Doubleplex stimulant-virus is over. Rewards for completing government missions have stabilizied.
10.Name: Doubleplex
10.Text: A short-lived virus artificially developed on Earth in 2117 as part of a series of experiments using the theory of relativity. Rumor has it that the infected become successful in virtually any endeavor, though this claim has never been proven. One known side effect of the virus is anemia, resulting in reduced attack and mobility. On the other hand, the infected are guaranteed greater rewards for completing government missions, as every planet has got its share of superstitious humanoids.

11.End: The effect of the Absolute Status stimulant is over. You can no longer count on easy missions and preferential treatment.
11.Name: Absolute Status
11.Text: Seen exclusively on bioscans in governmental institutions. Those with the status enjoy unusual, minimal requirements. Namely, the terms of offered government missions are less stringent.

2.End: The effect of the Stardust stimulant is over. The powder has passed from your system.
2.Name: Stardust
2.Text: A stimulant in the form of particle micropowder, recovered in close vicinity of black holes. For internal use only. Improves the brain function in creatures of any race for an prolonged period of time. Improves a whole set of skills.

3.End:
End=
The effect of the Super Technician stimulant is over. The biostimulant has passed from your system.
3.Name: Super Technician
3.Text: A faeyan biostimulant that improves technical skills. Equipment wear and tear becomes almost nonexistent. However, the duration is very limited.

4.End: The effect of the Gaalian Alacrity stimulant is over. Your brain activity is back to normal.
4.Name: Gaalian Alacrity
4.Text: A gaalian combat stimulant. Recommended for use in combat. Speeds up brain activity by several thousand times. Ship speed and firing accuracy see a sharp improvement.

5.End: The effect of the Blood Djogar is over. Your biological resistance to viruses has sharply decreased.
5.Name: Blood Djogar
5.Text: A solid oily clot from a maloq sand djogar. The stimulant improves blood supply by replacing regular blood cells with enhanced, artificial substitutes, making the body less susceptible to disease.

6.End: The effect of the Ragobam Whisper stimulant is over. You have lost the ability to eat ragobam bullfrogs and conduct flawless negotiations.
6.Name: Ragobam Whisper
6.Text: The stimulant is made from a tincture of filthy swamp slush, using radioactive extracts of ragobam bullfrog poison. Increases negotiation and persuasion skills, improving the pilot's likability. Additionally, it is safe to consume ragobam bullfrogs.

7.End: The effect of the Shakhmandoo Leader stimulant is over. The leadership and persuasion skills are decreased.
7.Name: Shakhmandoo Leader
7.Text: This peleng stimulant temporary inflates the subject's self-esteem -- a priceless quality for rallying others around you. The stimulant boosts leadership and enables you to conclude long-term contracts.

8.End: The effect of the Psychotropic Cache stimulant is over. The scanner and radar are back to normal operation. Charisma is back to normal as well.
8.Name: Psychotropic Cache
8.Text: The stimulator enables the brain to send impulse signals to the radar and scanner, tremendously boosting their capacity. The human scanner irritates everyone around him, eliciting a negative response no matter what he does.

9.End: The effect of the temporary Business Mark is over. Not even a trace of it is left on your skin.
9.Name: Business Mark
9.Text: A temporary hypodermic business mark. Indicates a wealth of experience in conducting commercial deals. Enables maximum profit when selling equipment (80% of actual value).

Stimulant.EndDate: The stimulator's effect will end on
